// tokenFile: Bearer token for every API call. Keep this file OUTSIDE any git tree, mode 0600.
// projects: The source of truth for work-order projects and their unique ID prefixes.
// verifyRepos: Repo name to local read-only clones used to verify submitted commits. An empty list explicitly means this machine has no clone.
// deployTrees: Optional repo name to the git tree that actually runs in production. restart-done verifies recorded commits against its HEAD.
// nudge: Chase whoever currently owes an action on an open order.
// delivery: Terminal-window agents only: back-pressure and the staleness cutoff.
// contextWatch: Warn an agent when its context window is close to full.
// notify: How to reach the human. 'none' | 'webhook' (POST {title, body}).
// remoteBridge: WebSocket endpoint for agents running on another machine.
